Sonia Gandhi's Memoir Launch Sparks Political Discussion and Legal Scrutiny

Sonia Gandhi launched her autobiography, "Belonging: A Journey of Love," in New Delhi on Monday. The event, attended by political figures including allies and opposition leaders, has become a subject of political discussion and legal scrutiny. While some reports highlight the emotional and personal aspects of the memoir, others focus on its political implications, including seating arrangements that fueled speculation about opposition unity. Separately, a Delhi court has requested a police report concerning a plea about Sonia Gandhi's 1980 voter roll entry.
